source: synthetic coordinates, synthetic energy and charging curves; no OSM

last_mile.name: Indian urban electric cargo three-wheeler
last_mile.story: Long multi-drop city loop; compare AC-only and hypothetical DC-capable operation.

coach.name: Regional battery-electric coach
coach.story: Closed intercity loop with a few high-power roadside chargers; the stop sequence is fixed.

truck.name: Heavy-duty electric freight truck
truck.story: A large outbound payload is delivered progressively; charging choices are made en route.

outage.name: Peri-urban station-density and outage network
outage.story: Same fixed urban-peripheral delivery loop, nested station sets, and a one-station outage.

last_mile.note: Charging powers and DC acceptance are hypothetical; do not claim the specified three-wheeler supports DC charging.

coach.note: Stops have zero deliveries; no passenger boarding/alighting dynamics.

truck.note: Linear load model not calibrated for commercial vehicles.

outage.note: Nested candidate sets, deterministic outage; no charger queues.
